entity: Oroville Hospital's excess Medicare inpatient stays and sepsis coding
what_we_add: The measured rate: 1.78 stays per patient, tied highest of 2,109 big hospitals (median 1.34), and sepsis codes on 30% of stays vs a 15% California median
why: The DOJ settlement (quote verified) and KRCR report exactly this: unnecessary inpatient admissions, per-admission kickbacks and false SIRS/sepsis codes at Oroville, 2013-2023. Source 0's quote is missing so it's out; sources 1-2 carry it. Our claims-data numbers appear in no source.
